goal: Detect when fuzz corpora silently stop reaching critical code paths during replay CI
Ensure changes to code or corpus inputs maintain test coverage of high-value internal execution paths
agreement: Support for adding immediate value to fuzzing CI (dergoegge, maflcko)
Nonblocking objection: mempool check could pass trivially on empty files without checking features (maflcko)
Question about cleanup behavior on exit was resolved (Crypt-iQ)
Concept approval without stated reasons (brunoerg, nervana21)

categories.name: tests
why: P2 because it prevents silent coverage regressions across high-value execution paths in fuzz targets
Corpus CI currently only detects crashes or sanitizer triggers rather than lost path coverage
